newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stock exchange says processing 19 listing cases.
newsitem.headline: HK stock exchange says processing 19 listing cases.

text.p: The Stock exchange of Hong Kong Ltd said on Thursday it is processing a total of 19 applications for a listing in Hong Kong and that there are 10 companies approved by its listing committee but still not yet listed.
All 19 companies have submitted advance booking forms for equity and debt securities (A1 forms) and furnished all required and necessary information, it said in a statement.
A further four companies have submitted the A1 forms but their cases were either inactive or on hold.
The bourse said it also received preliminary enquiries from nine companies but A1 forms were not yet submitted.
A total of 20 companies including three H-share companies were listed on the exchange this year up to April 21, the exchange said.
